title: Chile Grid Interconnection Note For Large Electricity Loads

sections.text: Large data center and cloud-region electricity requests can increase grid interconnection pressure around Santiago. The note flags substation queues, transmission congestion, and the need for staged approvals for new high-load facilities.
The regulator does not attribute all grid stress to AI infrastructure. Mining, electrification, and industrial demand remain competing explanations.

title: Brazilian Local Coverage Of Data Center Water Permitting
text: Moradores e grupos ambientais questionam o consumo de agua de um novo campus de data centers. A reportagem descreve audiencia publica, licenciamento ambiental, refrigeracao, emprego local e preocupacoes sobre tarifas de energia.

title: Cloud Provider Announces Latin America AI Region Expansion
text: ExampleCloud announced plans to expand AI-capable cloud regions in Chile and Brazil, citing demand from banks, retailers, and public-sector sovereign AI programs. The announcement emphasizes renewable procurement but does not quantify water use or local grid upgrade costs.

title: Policy Brief On Sovereign AI And Cloud Dependency In Latin America

sections.text: La dependencia de proveedores de nube extranjeros puede limitar la soberania digital, la portabilidad de datos y la capacidad de negociacion de gobiernos latinoamericanos.
El informe recomienda requisitos de transparencia, compras publicas condicionadas y evaluaciones de energia y agua para centros de datos de IA.

title: Public Comments On Data Center Electricity Prices In Mexico
text: Residents at a municipal hearing raised concerns that data center expansion could increase electricity prices, strain local water supplies, and benefit foreign cloud companies more than local communities. The sample is not representative polling and should be treated only as a public-opinion signal.
